meta.profile: Senior Marketing / Growth / GTM / Partnerships leader, SF Bay Area, $160k+ base, B2B SaaS / AI / fintech focus

tier1_highest_volume.name: LinkedIn Jobs
tier1_highest_volume.notes: Largest single source. Use salary filter f_SB2=6 (>$160k). Sort by date (sortBy=DD). Scrape job IDs, resolve to ATS URLs.

tier1_highest_volume.name: Greenhouse Job Board (direct)
tier1_highest_volume.notes: VERIFIED DEAD 2026-07-19: boards.greenhouse.io/search returns 404. Greenhouse has no cross-company search page. Use tier6_direct_company_careers (per-company boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{slug}/jobs) instead — real public JSON API, no login.

tier1_highest_volume.name: Ashby Job Board (direct)
tier1_highest_volume.notes: VERIFIED DEAD 2026-07-19: jobs.ashbyhq.com/search returns 'Page not found'. Ashby has no cross-company search. Use tier6_direct_company_careers (per-company api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{slug}) instead — unofficial but working public JSON API, no login.

tier1_highest_volume.name: Lever Job Board (direct)
tier1_highest_volume.notes: VERIFIED DEAD 2026-07-19: jobs.lever.co/search returns 404. Lever has no cross-company search. Use tier6_direct_company_careers (per-company api.lever.co/v0/postings/{slug}?mode=json) instead — real public JSON API, no login.

tier2_high_signal.name: Built In SF
tier2_high_signal.notes: Curated SF+remote tech. Seniority filter critical — most roles are IC. Use built-in salary filter when available.

tier2_high_signal.name: Wellfound (AngelList)
tier2_high_signal.notes: Strong for Series A-C startups. Already have wellfound-apply skill. Salary filter available.

tier2_high_signal.name: Y Combinator Jobs
tier2_high_signal.notes: YC portfolio companies. High quality signal. Many use Ashby. Filter for 'Senior' and above.

tier2_high_signal.name: Work at a Startup (HN)
tier2_high_signal.notes: HN/YC community board. Already have workatastartup skill. Use exp=4 (director+).

tier2_high_signal.name: ExecThread
tier2_high_signal.notes: Executive-only referral network. Invite-required for posting but free to search. High match quality for VP+.

tier2_high_signal.name: Lenny's Newsletter Jobs
tier2_high_signal.notes: Product/growth/marketing focused. Smaller volume but very high quality. Most roles are product growth or marketing leadership.

tier3_specialist.name: Crunchbase Jobs
tier3_specialist.notes: Funded startup focus. Good for Series B+ companies. Cross-reference funding stage with company page.

tier3_specialist.name: Glassdoor Jobs
tier3_specialist.notes: Large volume but high noise. Salary filter and seniority filter essential.

tier3_specialist.name: Indeed
tier3_specialist.notes: High volume, mixed quality. Filter: salary >$160k, senior level. Many repost from ATS — dedup by company+title.

tier3_specialist.name: Remote OK
tier3_specialist.notes: Strong for fully remote roles. Has public JSON API. Filter by salary and seniority in API response.

tier3_specialist.name: The Muse
tier3_specialist.notes: Company culture + job listings. Good for filtering by company values. Seniority filter available.

tier3_specialist.name: Dice
tier3_specialist.notes: Primarily tech roles. Useful for growth/marketing-tech hybrid roles at established tech companies.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: HN Who's Hiring (monthly thread)
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: HN monthly 'Who's Hiring' thread via Algolia API. Scrape comments, grep for marketing/growth/VP/director. Small but very high signal — often early-stage or stealth companies.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: Pallet Jobs
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: Creator/newsletter-curated job boards. Several marketing-focused pallets with senior roles.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: Marketing Hire
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: Marketing-only job board. Smaller but highly filtered — every role is marketing.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: Jobgether
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: Remote-first jobs. Good salary filter. Aggregates from multiple sources.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: Himalayas
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: Remote-first, good filtering. Emerging board with clean job data.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: Arc.dev
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: Mostly engineering but has marketing/growth roles. Worth occasional check.

tier5_aggregators.name: Otta
tier5_aggregators.notes: Good seniority filters (5=director, 6=VP+). Strong for EU-originated companies with US offices.

tier5_aggregators.name: Simplyhired
tier5_aggregators.notes: Aggregator. Lower noise than Indeed but same dedup required.

tier5_aggregators.name: ZipRecruiter
tier5_aggregators.notes: Large volume. Salary filter + 7-day recency essential to reduce noise.

tier6_direct_company_careers.notes: Verified 2026-07-19 via live API calls (no login required). Greenhouse/Lever have real public JSON APIs; Ashby uses an unofficial but working public endpoint. Cross-company search pages for all three ATSes are DEAD (see tier1 notes) — this per-company list is the only reliable no-login path. job_count_verified is total open roles at verification time (not filtered to marketing/senior) — apply seniority_gate + search_keywords filter when querying each api_url. Expanded round 2 (2026-07-19): +28 companies (Braze, Fivetran, Klaviyo, Harvey, Sierra, 1Password, Supabase, Outreach, Attentive, Tailscale, Salesloft, and more). Round 3 (2026-07-19): +32 companies (Zscaler, Adyen, Block, Chime, SoFi, LaunchDarkly, Betterment, PagerDuty, Persona, PostHog, Sardine, and more fintech/security/devtools). Expanded round 3 (2026-07-29): +48 companies verified live via Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever/SmartRecruiters public APIs, 164 total tracked.

weekly_rotation: Run tier1 sources (LinkedIn, direct Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever) every session
Run tier2 sources (Built In SF, Wellfound, YC, ExecThread, Lenny's) every 3 days
Run HN Who's Hiring API on first Monday of each month
Scan tier6 direct company career pages weekly (automate via HTTP batch)
search_strategy.dedup_strategy: Primary key: (company_name + job_title). Secondary: ATS job_id. Normalize company names (strip Inc/LLC/Corp). Cache seen job IDs in ~/.claude/skills/greenhouse-apply/data/seen-job-ids.json
search_strategy.salary_gate: Skip any listing where max_salary < 160000 OR no salary shown AND company stage is seed/pre-seed. Request salary info if Greenhouse form has salary field.
search_strategy.seniority_gate: Only apply to: Director, Senior Director, VP, SVP, EVP, Head of, CMO, CGO. Skip: Manager, Senior Manager, Lead, Principal (unless title contains 'Group' or equivalent).
